card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as the 6 in 60°F or the 4 in 2,947. It is often followed by more digits or a dash range.

modes.label: Number inside a measurement
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside a temperature, dose or count.

modes.label: Number in a citation or page range
modes.description: A digit inside a year, volume or page range in a reference.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a longer number, where more digits are expected to follow.
